title: 4 Dreamy Florida Airbnbs With Pools and Waterfront Views - NewsBreak
text:
By Kelly Carroll ,
5 hours ago
Are you ready to take a break from your inbox and busy schedule to unwind? Spending the afternoon by the pool, gazing at an unbelievable view, sounds like a fantastic way to relax and reset. Florida offers top-notch vacation destinations, and we’ve found some of the best. Here are four of the best water feature Airbnbs in Florida.
1. A Massive Gulf-Front Estate With Breathtaking Views — Alys Beach, Florida Photo courtesy of Airbnb Everything about this Alys Beach, Florida, Airbnb is stunning. With almost 8,000 square feet, nine bedrooms, and 9.5 bathrooms, there’s ample room for multiple families or a group of friends to spread out. Inside, the home’s open-concept kitchen, dining, and living areas are perfect for easy meals and impromptu gatherings. An expansive pool deck runs along the entire back side of the home, and the infinity-edge pool includes a hot tub and swim-up bar. The postcard-worthy Gulf views from inside and outside of the home elevate it to one of the top luxury Airbnbs in Florida.
2. A Luxurious Oceanfront Home With A Swoonworthy Outdoor Kitchen — Marathon, Florida Photo courtesy of Airbnb Known for fantastic fishing, beautiful beaches, and warm weather, Marathon, Florida, is a wonderful getaway destination for anglers and sun-worshippers. This luxurious Airbnb is in the heart of the Florida Keys and boasts four bedrooms and four bathrooms. It has a large kitchen and an adjacent comfortable living space, but I suspect guests won’t want to spend much time indoors; the outdoor space is first-rate. There’s an oceanfront infinity-edge pool surrounded by a covered outdoor kitchen and dining area. A hammock on the edge of the property looks like the ideal place for an afternoon nap. As if that weren’t enough, boaters can also enjoy an 80-foot dock.
Visitors of the Florida Keys should consider taking the best American road trip in Florida , which goes from Mile Marker 110 to Mile Marker 0 on the Florida Keys Scenic Byway. The drive passes through delightful small towns with unforgettable views. It also includes Key West, a Florida gem with unique architecture and incredible nightlife.
3. A Bayfront Retreat With Massive Windows — Edgewater, Florida Photo courtesy of Airbnb This Edgewater, Florida, Airbnb is designed for those who love relaxing outdoors. The home has five bedrooms and six bathrooms, and its outdoor spaces include a large saltwater infinity pool, a hot tub, and an outdoor kitchen. The outdoor kitchen has four TVs; I can imagine enjoying a game, along with delicious snacks and appetizers here. The Airbnb’s interior has a gourmet kitchen with a double oven and an island. There’s also a movie theater with nine recliners, perfect for enjoying a late-night movie.
There’s no shortage of things to do in Edgewater, Florida. Visitors can enjoy a dolphin tour or visit Menard-Mays Park and Whistle Stop Park. Nearby restaurants include Tipsy Unicorn’s Brewing, a hidden gem microbrewery with delicious craft beers and a pickle flight!
4. A Gorgeous Estate With a Two-Story Screened Lanai and Zero-Edge Pool — Cape Coral, Florida Photo courtesy of Airbnb Cape Coral is known for its unique, extensive canal system, and this waterfront Airbnb in Florida offers guests incredible panoramic canal views. The 5,000-square-foot home has five bedroom suites, each with a private bathroom, making this an ideal destination for couples. The open layout includes a gourmet kitchen, dining area, and comfortable living space. There’s plenty of room to prepare and enjoy meals or just relax and catch up. Outdoors, an infinity-edge pool sits beside the canal, providing amazing water views. It’s covered with a two-story screened lanai, so guests won’t have to worry about bugs ruining their fun. Nearby, a covered outdoor dining area provides a wonderful place to enjoy meals and a break from the sun.
If you’re interested in seeing even more of the best stays with views in Florida, check out this list of Airbnbs near springs in Florida . These Airbnbs are in prime locations for enjoying the state’s amazing natural springs. Guests can enjoy hiking, paddling, and incredible water views.
